terra.problem: The verse says her eyes have overcome him, not that she is paying him attention or that her eyes are doing the opposite of ignoring him.
The passage does not say nobody is forgetting anything or that the man wrote the poem.
The cookie joke does not match the picture of pairs with none missing. Perfect cookies with no bites taken are not the same as a matched, complete set.
The text says the maidens see her and call her blessed. It does not say they take one look and start cheering.
The watch joke puts a modern object into the Bible scene rather than using it as an everyday comparison.
The text does not say whether the maidens walk past her or stop.
The passage does not place the women in a room or say they have the most titles there.
The passage does not identify the season as spring.
The passage does not identify the speaker as male.
The speaker checks whether the vines are budding and the pomegranates are in bloom. The passage does not establish that nothing is withered.
The passage does not say the speaker ended up somewhere else after visiting the grove.
The kitchen comparison has no stated outcome that matches the speaker's unexpected experience, so the joke does not land.
The text says the speaker did not realize it before their desire set them among the chariots. It does not say where the walk ended or what the speaker had planned.
